from PIL import Image
import numpy as np
im=np.array(Image.open('chess_board.png').convert('RGB')).astype(int)
bg1=np.array([240,217,181]); bg2=np.array([181,136,99])
for r in range(8):
  for c in range(8):
    cell=im[r*80:(r+1)*80, c*80:(c+1)*80]
    d1=np.all(np.abs(cell-bg1)<=3,axis=2)
    d2=np.all(np.abs(cell-bg2)<=3,axis=2)
    bg=d1|d2
    # piece pixels = strong deviation from both backgrounds: dark or white
    lum=cell.mean(axis=2)
    piece=(~bg)&((lum<120)|(lum>225))
    ys,xs=np.where(piece)
    if len(ys)<50: continue
    # focus bbox; ignore possible coordinate text component by taking largest? for now bbox
    y0,y1,x0,x1=ys.min(),ys.max(),xs.min(),xs.max()
    sub=piece[y0:y1+1,x0:x1+1]
    # downsample to ~16 wide preserving aspect
    H,W=sub.shape
    out=[]
    for yy in range(16):
      line=''
      for xx in range(16):
        aa=sub[int(yy*H/16):max(int((yy+1)*H/16),int(yy*H/16)+1), int(xx*W/16):max(int((xx+1)*W/16),int(xx*W/16)+1)]
        frac=aa.mean()
        line+= '#' if frac>0.5 else ('+' if frac>0.2 else '.')
      out.append(line)
    print('=== r%d c%d %s bbox=%s size=%s'%(r,c,'BLACK' if (im[r*80:(r+1)*80,c*80:(c+1)*80].mean(axis=2)<100).sum()>50 else 'WHITE', (y0,y1,x0,x1),(H,W)))
    print('\n'.join(out))

from PIL import Image
import numpy as np
from collections import defaultdict
im=np.array(Image.open('chess_board.png').convert('RGB')).astype(int)
bg1=np.array([240,217,181]); bg2=np.array([181,136,99])
groups=defaultdict(list)
for r in range(8):
  for c in range(8):
    cell=im[r*80:(r+1)*80, c*80:(c+1)*80]
    d1=np.all(np.abs(cell-bg1)<=3,axis=2); d2=np.all(np.abs(cell-bg2)<=3,axis=2)
    bg=d1|d2
    # strong non-bg: any channel far from both bg? use color distance
    dist1=np.abs(cell-bg1).sum(axis=2); dist2=np.abs(cell-bg2).sum(axis=2)
    piece=(~bg)&(np.minimum(dist1,dist2)>60)
    ys,xs=np.where(piece)
    if len(ys)<50: continue
    # connected components not needed; exclude coordinate text by requiring bbox area > 300
    y0,y1,x0,x1=ys.min(),ys.max(),xs.min(),xs.max()
    sub=piece[y0:y1+1,x0:x1+1]
    if sub.shape[0]*sub.shape[1] < 300: continue
    key=(sub.shape, sub.tobytes())
    groups[key].append((r,c))
for i,(key,cells) in enumerate(sorted(groups.items(), key=lambda kv: str(kv[1]))):
    shape=key[0]
    print('GROUP',i,'shape',shape,'cells',cells)

from PIL import Image
import numpy as np
from collections import defaultdict, deque
im=np.array(Image.open('chess_board.png').convert('RGB')).astype(int)
bg1=np.array([240,217,181]); bg2=np.array([181,136,99])

def largest_component(mask):
    H,W=mask.shape
    seen=np.zeros_like(mask,bool)
    best=[]
    for y in range(H):
        for x in range(W):
            if mask[y,x] and not seen[y,x]:
                q=deque([(y,x)]); seen[y,x]=True; comp=[]
                while q:
                    a,b=q.popleft(); comp.append((a,b))
                    for da,db in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                        na,nb=a+da,b+db
                        if 0<=na<H and 0<=nb<W and mask[na,nb] and not seen[na,nb]:
                            seen[na,nb]=True; q.append((na,nb))
                if len(comp)>len(best): best=comp
    out=np.zeros_like(mask,bool)
    for a,b in best: out[a,b]=True
    return out, len(best)

pieces={}
for r in range(8):
  for c in range(8):
    cell=im[r*80:(r+1)*80, c*80:(c+1)*80]
    dist1=np.abs(cell-bg1).sum(axis=2); dist2=np.abs(cell-bg2).sum(axis=2)
    piece=(np.minimum(dist1,dist2)>60)
    comp,n=largest_component(piece)
    if n<100: continue
    # determine black or white by mean color of component
    vals=cell[comp]
    # black glyph filled: many dark pixels; white outline: many >240
    blackfrac=((vals.mean(axis=1)<80)).mean()
    whitefrac=((vals.mean(axis=1)>235)).mean()
    color='B' if blackfrac>whitefrac else 'W'
    ys,xs=np.where(comp)
    y0,y1,x0,x1=ys.min(),ys.max(),xs.min(),xs.max()
    sub=comp[y0:y1+1,x0:x1+1]
    pieces[(r,c)]=(color,sub,n)

# group by shape normalized: compare masks after resizing to 24x24 with simple area sampling
def norm(sub,S=24):
    H,W=sub.shape
    out=np.zeros((S,S),bool)
    for yy in range(S):
        for xx in range(S):
            a=sub[int(yy*H/S):max(int((yy+1)*H/S),int(yy*H/S)+1), int(xx*W/S):max(int((xx+1)*W/S),int(xx*W/S)+1)]
            out[yy,xx]=a.mean()>0.5
    return out

# Print each piece ASCII 24x24, plus color and size
for (r,c),(color,sub,n) in sorted(pieces.items()):
    print(f'=== r{r} c{c} {color} size={sub.shape} n={n}')
    z=norm(sub,20)
    for row in z:
        print(''.join('#' if v else '.' for v in row))
EOF

from PIL import Image, ImageDraw, ImageFont
import numpy as np
fontpath='/usr/share/fonts/truetype/dejavu/DejaVuSans.ttf'
chars={'K':'\u2654','Q':'\u2655','R':'\u2656','B':'\u2657','N':'\u2658','P':'\u2659',
       'k':'\u265A','q':'\u265B','r':'\u265C','b':'\u265D','n':'\u265E','p':'\u265F'}
for size in [60,64,68]:
  print('##### fontsize',size)
  for k,ch in chars.items():
    img=Image.new('L',(100,100),0)
    d=ImageDraw.Draw(img)
    f=ImageFont.truetype(fontpath,size)
    d.text((10,10),ch,font=f,fill=255)
    a=np.array(img)>128
    ys,xs=np.where(a)
    if len(ys)==0:
      print(k,'missing'); continue
    sub=a[ys.min():ys.max()+1,xs.min():xs.max()+1]
    # print 16x16
    S=16; H,W=sub.shape
    out=[]
    for yy in range(S):
      line=''
      for xx in range(S):
        aa=sub[int(yy*H/S):max(int((yy+1)*H/S),int(yy*H/S)+1), int(xx*W/S):max(int((xx+1)*W/S),int(xx*W/S)+1)]
        line+='#' if aa.mean()>0.5 else '.'
      out.append(line)
    print('---',k,ch,sub.shape)
    print('\n'.join(out))
